questions: How many devices did you measure, and how many showed the e/4 period? The Methods describe one device (p. 9), and Fig. 1b shows "a device with the air-bridge".
If there were others, why were they set aside, and how many cooldowns do the data span?

Which ADG, side-gate and field windows did you measure at each filling beyond those shown (Fig. 2a spans 35 mT and 0.7 V), and how many side-gate settings did you try before reaching the minimal-excitation regime?

What does a second minimal-regime dataset at ν = −5/2 look like? Those oscillations are "considerably weaker than at the other fillings" (Fig. S8, p. 20), and the spacing histogram gives 51.56 ± 23 mV next to 62.8 mV from the FFT.
The ADG windows run from about −3.6 V to +3.4 V across fillings (Fig. 2a–d), and ΔV1 comes from ν = −1 at 10 T. Is the ADG lever arm the same across those windows?
Did you check gate leakage from the air bridge and side gates up to 5 V, and do repeated sweeps at the e/4 states reproduce as at ν = 2/3 (Fig. S13)?

Could you extract the charging energy from the DC-bias maps (Figs. S8c–S11c), and remeasure ν = −5/2 over a longer field window? Its 5.9 ± 2.6 mT period has about six 1 mT steps per period over 35 mT (Fig. 2a).

Your earlier antidot doubled its period at integer ν = 2 and 4 as coupling grew (arXiv 2504.16750). Did you tune the side gates at ν = −1 or −2 here? At ν = −5/2 the minimal and doubled maps sit in different ADG windows (Fig. S8a, g); was that doubling reached by side gates alone?
